grammar.pattern: 都 + 状态 / 数量 + 了
grammar.explanation: 都十点了 highlights lateness in context. 都 refers to the advanced state, not necessarily every object. 都这么晚了 expresses the speaker’s evaluation; verify actual clock time separately.

examples.py: dōu shí diǎn le , xiān jié shù ba .
examples.en: It is already ten; let us stop first.

examples.py: dōu zhè me wǎn le , bié zài děng .
examples.en: It is already so late; do not keep waiting.

examples.zh: 都三天了，还没收到回答。
examples.py: dōu sān tiān le , hái mò shōu dào huí dá .
examples.en: It has already been three days without a reply.

commonMistakes.right: 都十点了强调已经十点，不是钟的数量。
commonMistakes.why: Read the advanced-time use of 都.

grammar.pattern: X 就 X 点儿吧
grammar.explanation: 晚就晚点儿吧 concedes a little lateness rather than claiming lateness never matters. 累就累点儿吧 is language of reluctant acceptance, not advice to ignore exhaustion. This pattern does not override limits, consent or safety.

examples.zh: 晚就晚点儿吧，先告诉她。
examples.py: wǎn jiù wǎn diǎn ér ba , xiān gào sù tā .
examples.en: A little late is acceptable; tell her first.

examples.zh: 少就少点儿吧，别强迫别人。
examples.py: shǎo jiù shǎo diǎn ér ba , bié qiǎng pò bié ren .
examples.en: A little less is acceptable; do not force others.

examples.zh: 慢就慢点儿吧，先说准确。
examples.py: màn jiù màn diǎn ér ba , xiān shuō zhǔn què .
examples.en: A little slower is acceptable; say it accurately first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 慢就慢点儿吧表示必须加快。
commonMistakes.right: 慢就慢点儿吧是接受慢一点，不是要求加快。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern concedes the stated degree.

dialogue.title: Close the evening
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what is reported and what remains unknown.

lines.zh: 都这么晚了，今天就到这里吧。钟上十点，但还没核对。
lines.py: dōu zhè me wǎn le , jīn tiān jiù dào zhè lǐ ba . zhōng shàng shí diǎn , dàn hái méi hé duì .
lines.en: It is already so late; stop here today. The clock shows ten but is unverified.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 慢就慢点儿吧，先把情况说准确。调查结束了吗？
lines.py: màn jiù màn diǎn ér ba , xiān bǎ qíng kuàng shuō zhǔn què . diào chá jié shù le ma ?
lines.en: A little slower is acceptable; describe the situation accurately first. Is the investigation finished?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 没有。她否认发通知，不等于事实确认。警察到场也不是结束。
lines.py: méi yǒu . tā fǒu rèn fā tōng zhī , bù děng yú shì shí què rèn . jǐng chá dào chǎng yě bù shì jié shù .
lines.en: No. She denies sending the notice, but facts are not confirmed; police arriving is not completion.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 故事里手指出血，她拿了凉水，是治疗建议吗？
lines.py: gù shì lǐ shǒu zhǐ chū xiě , tā ná le liáng shuǐ , shì zhì liáo jiàn yì ma ?
lines.en: In the story a finger bleeds and she takes cool water. Is this treatment advice?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不是，是虚构台词。紧急情况联系当地负责的人，不靠故事猜。
lines.py: bù shì , shì xū gòu tái cí . jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì dāng dì fù zé de rén , bù kào gù shì cāi .
lines.en: No, it is fictional dialogue. Contact the responsible local person in an emergency instead of guessing from a story.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。空调关了吗？卫生间在门后右边，退场前再问。
lines.py: hǎo . kōng tiáo guān le ma ? wèi shēng jiān zài mén hòu yòu biān , tuì chǎng qián zài wèn .
lines.en: Good. Is the air conditioner off? The bathroom is to the right behind the door; ask before leaving.
lines.speaker: b

choices: To the right behind the door
To the left outside the building
questions.answer: To the right behind the door

reading.title: Respect limits at closing
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 她退休以后仍来活动，公务员也可能在休假；被调到新部门和到场时间不同。
lines.py: tā tuì xiū yǐ hòu réng lái huó dòng , gōng wù yuán yě kě néng zài xiū jià ; bèi diào dào xīn bù mén hé dào chǎng shí jiān bù tóng .
lines.en: She attends after retirement; a civil servant may be on leave; transfer and attendance time differ.

lines.zh: 离婚经历属于本人，不追问；植物死的原因没有写，不替故事猜。
lines.py: lí hūn jīng lì shǔ yú běn rén , bù zhuī wèn ; zhí wù sǐ de yuán yīn méi yǒu xiě , bù tì gù shì cāi .
lines.en: Divorce belongs to the person; do not press; the plant’s cause of death is unstated, so do not guess.

lines.zh: 卫生与卫生间是否能用要问现场，颜色不证明卫生。别用包压门。
lines.py: wèi shēng yǔ wèi shēng jiān shì fǒu néng yòng yào wèn xiàn chǎng , yán sè bù zhèng míng wèi shēng . bié yòng bāo yā mén .
lines.en: Ask about hygiene and bathroom use locally; colour does not prove hygiene; do not prop the door with a bag.

lines.zh: 她想问大夫；交警和警察的台词只用于理解，不给真实办事或急救步骤。
lines.py: tā xiǎng wèn dài fu ; jiāo jǐng hé jǐng chá de tái cí zhǐ yòng yú lǐ jiě , bù gěi zhēn shí bàn shì huò jí jiù bù zhòu .
lines.en: She wants to ask a doctor; traffic and police dialogue is for comprehension, not actual procedural or first-aid steps.

lines.zh: 有烟就先说明现场情况，救人剧情不代替当地求助。危害和诊断不靠一句判断。
lines.py: yǒu yān jiù xiān shuō míng xiàn chǎng qíng kuàng , jiù rén jù qíng bù dài tì dāng dì qiú zhù . wēi hài hé zhěn duàn bù kào yī jù pàn duàn .
lines.en: If smoke is present, describe actual conditions; rescue fiction does not replace local help; do not infer harm or diagnosis from one sentence.

lines.zh: 都十点了，晚就晚点儿吧，先联系；退场是今天结束，不是以前记录消失。
lines.py: dōu shí diǎn le , wǎn jiù wǎn diǎn ér ba , xiān lián xì ; tuì chǎng shì jīn tiān jié shù , bù shì yǐ qián jì lù xiāo shī .
lines.en: It is already ten; a little lateness is acceptable, but contact people first; leaving ends today, not prior records.
